name: Les Cyclopes
source: ImageGen concept → Meshy 7.1 → Meshy remesh; original visor/frame retained, rear stems rebuilt in Blender from the author’s natural-fit reference
reference_role: Shape and funky palette only; no brand or product texture reproduced
modifications: 16/18 mm approach retained. Meshy rear arms clipped and sections closed; 1038 mirror triangles retain positions, UVs and corner normals. New 3.2x1.8 mm stems follow the scalp with a short 9 mm descending return; colours sampled from matte regions of the existing atlas.
calibration: Real Quaternius CC0 iris samples and faceted heads; no reference body exported
mirror: View-dependent tinted studio MatCap in existing Painted Toon; no scene reflection
rights: Generated through the project’s Meshy account; Quaternius calibration references CC0. Product photo is reference only.
delivery: Workshop/iPhone pilot; not a published server inventory item
fit_validation: Iris coverage and 24–30 mm relief unchanged; zero ear and temple-skin intersections; 21 face/nose combinations and headbands clear.
